player_prompt.intro: Kuna wasa da lambar ƙidayar ƙidayar! Manufa: Haɗa lambobi ta amfani da +, -, *, / don isa ga manufa. Tsarin aiki: [i j op] inda i,j sune alamomi kuma op shine aikin. Misali: [0 2 *] yana ninka lamba a lamba 0 tare da lamba a lamba 2. Raba dole ne ya haifar da lambobi masu yawa kawai.

board.header: TARGET: {target} Lambobin da ake da su: {numbers}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tsarin aiki ba daidai ba. Amfani da `[i j op]` inda i,j su ne masu alama da op shine +,-,*,/

invalid_move.invalid_operation: Ayyukan da ba daidai ba (raba ta hanyar sifili ko sakamakon da ba lamba ba)
